caption:
$900K Etobicoke home: two closing taxes?

Example: a $900,000 home in the City of Toronto, no refund. Ontario land transfer tax: $55,000 x 0.5% = $275; next $195,000 x 1% = $1,950; next $150,000 x 1.5% = $2,250; last $500,000 x 2% = $10,000. Total: $14,475. Toronto's municipal land transfer tax uses the same brackets at this price: $14,475. Both together: $28,950, before any first-time buyer refund. Legal fees, title insurance and adjustments are extra.

Sources: City of Toronto, Municipal land transfer tax rates (rates as of Apr 1, 2026; page modified Apr 7, 2026); Ontario.ca, Calculating land transfer tax. Eligibility rules apply to refunds.

Last band. Toronto's tax on the remaining five hundred thousand at two percent: ten thousand dollars.
So all in, both taxes come to twenty-eight thousand, nine hundred fifty dollars.

Own in Toronto? April 30 matters.

The City of Toronto reported on Nov 2, 2026 that the 2026 Vacant Home Tax declaration period is open. Council set the 2026 tax at 3% of a property's assessed value (current value assessment). The declaration covers how the home was used from Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2026, and owners can declare online through the City's portal until April 30, 2027. My take: put the date in your calendar, and ask the City or your lawyer if you're unsure how it applies to you.

Source: City of Toronto news release, Nov 2, 2026.
